title: Electricity Cutoff APK Scam
tagline: An urgent SMS threatens power disconnection tonight unless you install a fake support APK.
intro: An SMS claims your home electricity will be disconnected at 9:30 PM unless you install {{fakeApkName}} or call {{maskedPhone}} to update your previous bill.

payloadTemplate.body: ALERT: Power supply will be DISCONNECTED tonight at 9:30 PM due to unpaid ₹{{amount}} bill. Download {{fakeApkName}} or call {{maskedPhone}} immediately.

steps.label: Spot the APK red flags and block the SMS sender
steps.cue: Never download .apk files from SMS or WhatsApp alerts threatening same-night disconnection.
steps.explanation: Real electricity boards send billing notices through official portals and never ask consumers to sideload .apk files.

steps.label: Hang up on the fake electricity support caller
steps.cue: End the follow-up pressure call immediately instead of sharing OTPs or remote screen access.
steps.explanation: Scammers call seconds after the SMS to pressure victims into installing screen-sharing or OTP-stealing APKs.

steps.label: Report the phishing number & APK to 1930
steps.cue: Submit the suspicious mobile number and APK name on 1930 / Chakshu / cybercrime.gov.in.
steps.explanation: Reporting the scam number and APK filename helps telecom & cybercrime teams block the fraud campaign.

props.title: SMS Inbox
props.subtitle: Tap red flags inside the message before acting
props.body: ALERT: Power supply will be DISCONNECTED tonight at 9:30 PM due to unpaid ₹{{amount}} bill. Download {{fakeApkName}} or call {{maskedPhone}} immediately.

actions.label: Block SMS sender & verify on official board site

trapIntents.INSTALL_APK: Sideloading {{fakeApkName}} gives scammers background permission to intercept SMS OTPs and drain your bank account.
trapIntents.CLICK_EXTERNAL_LINK: External links inside cutoff threats lead to credential harvesting or malicious APK downloads.

notification.title: {{callerAgency}}
notification.body: Calling from {{maskedPhone}} about your power meter.

props.title: Incoming Call
props.transcript: Sir your meter will be cut in 15 minutes unless you install {{fakeApkName}} and read me the 6-digit OTP to sync your ₹{{amount}} payment.

extraActions.label: Read back 6-digit OTP to clear bill

trapIntents.ANSWER_CALL: Staying on the line allows scammers to intimidate you into installing remote-control APKs.
trapIntents.SHARE_OTP: Giving an OTP allows attackers to log into your mobile banking or authorise a payment.

props.title: Report Phishing APK & Number
props.intro: Report the fake electricity disconnection alert and malicious APK filename.

critical.title: You installed an unverified APK or shared an OTP
critical.explanation: Fake utility support APKs like {{fakeApkName}} silently forward SMS OTPs and allow remote device control. Never sideload APK files from texts or share OTPs with callers. Enable Aeroplane Mode, uninstall unknown apps, freeze banking via {{bankName}}, and call 1930 immediately.
critical.reason: You fell for an APK / OTP trap on a utility cutoff scare last time, so rehearse spotting .apk alerts next.

redFlags.label: Midnight cutoff panic
redFlags.explanation: Scammers create fake same-night disconnection deadlines so you act without checking your official utility app.

redFlags.label: Unknown .apk file
redFlags.explanation: Genuine electricity providers never send .apk installer files over SMS or WhatsApp.

redFlags.label: Personal mobile number
redFlags.explanation: Official utility notices use registered consumer helplines, not random 10-digit mobile numbers.

hints.inspect-power-sms: Tap the suspicious phrases in the SMS, then block the sender—never download {{fakeApkName}}.
hints.reject-helpline-call: Tap Hang up immediately. Real electricity officers never ask for OTPs or APK installs.
hints.file-1930-apk: Choose a reason and submit the report to 1930 so the scam number and APK can be flagged.
